questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer:
*New Culture (South East Asia)
*Academic Quality (highest ranked university in asia resulting in career opportunities)

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Lot of information scattered across 5 ish powerpoint. Not very concise, and many different application processes.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Sign up for orientation was very early in process - forgot to do it.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: 4 types - mostly single room with or without ac

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: 2 types have meal plans otherwise you have a kitchen. There are plenty of cheap canteens .

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Try for aircon. Better to not be forced to take meal plan and instead have freedom to buy from canteens.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Many steps. Make sure to plan it out as certain reg require previous steps + approval.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Got what I wanted - but fill out all 10 options and appeal when you dont get something. On appeal they are looser with criteria.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Fill out all 10 options and appeal when you dont get something. On appeal they are looser with criteria.
